Staff AI Engineer
London, United Kingdom

Join us at Meridian Bank, where the problems are measured in billions.

You will be required to have experience in LEDGER Consolidation. It is a
multiyear initiative to bring the settlement platform onto supported hardware
and retire redundant functionality. You will lead the overall engineering of
this initiative and support discovery, delivery planning and roadmap.

To be successful in this role, you should have experience with:

Strong full-stack engineering using either Python or Java, including Python
with FastAPI/Django or Java with Spring Boot, together with modern frontend
technologies such as React, Angular or TypeScript.

Hands-on delivery of Generative AI solutions, including LLM integration, prompt
engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases and
agentic AI workflows.

Designing secure, scalable enterprise applications using microservices, REST
APIs, event-driven architecture, relational or NoSQL databases, authentication
and enterprise integration patterns.

Cloud-native engineering and DevSecOps, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD,
automated testing, observability, resilience and production support.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

AI framework experience such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic
Kernel or Spring AI.

MLOps and LLMOps knowledge, including prompt and model versioning, automated
evaluation, monitoring, guardrails and cost management.

Financial services or payments engineering experience, with an understanding of
responsible AI, data privacy and regulatory compliance.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role,
such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic
thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in our London office.

What you'll get in return
Competitive holiday allowance
Life assurance
Private medical care
Pension contribution
